styleLocks.art: Painterly dark-fantasy concept art, deep-mountain noir, cold blue-grey granite and soot-black shadow cut by warm amber lantern light, veins of pale opalescent violet glowing in the stone, drifting rock dust in the air, cinematic composition, highly detailed environment, 16:9 aspect ratio.
styleLocks.map: Top-down orthographic fantasy battle map for a virtual tabletop, hand-painted digital illustration, lush and intricately detailed, saturated jewel-tone palette with deep contrasting shadows, dramatic glowing light sources casting colored pools of light, rich textures on stone, timber, moss and water, crisp readable shapes that stay clear under tokens, flat overhead view with no perspective tilt, medieval fantasy setting.

clocks.name: Until Dawn
clocks.goal: One segment per hour. At 8, Ammaskar sits up and the Gate recalls Boon.

steps.2: Midnight tremor: a lift-cage jams; Scene 3 rescue DCs +2 if the miners are still trapped.
steps.4: The town panics. Mayor Durrin decides to hand Boon to the giants at dawn.
steps.6: Dorn goes down on his own. Go to Scene 5 now.
steps.7: Kolgrim starts singing the mountain down (unless faced down). Scene 5 loses a round.
steps.8: Dawn. Ammaskar sits up; the Gate recalls Boon.

clocks.name: Corvane, the Hush Merchant
clocks.goal: Sell Haldra’s pact ring and the way into Dhurak-Ul

clocks.name: Bagathorn’s Grudge
clocks.goal: The town turns on Ironclad and the Gultors

starving-xorn.name: Starving Xorn
starving-xorn.notes: Starving, driven up from below. Goes for whoever carries the most gems and metal (Vali’s mithral and Sun Blade, Orek’s jeweler’s kit). Flees into the rock at 25 HP or less. A tossed gem, ring or 50+ gp (bonus action) makes the nearest xorn spend its next turn eating it. A crit on Vali chews his mithral: −1 AC until repaired. Tremorsense (Boon, Orek) cancels its advantage for surfacing next to a target.

dream-guardian.name: Dream-Guardian

traits.name: Dream-Laden Blows
traits.text: A creature hit by the guardian’s Slam makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or can’t take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

dream-guardian.notes: Steps out of the sealing wall. Moves through it freely and withdraws into it at half HP; drives intruders off and doesn’t chase. Vali holding up the rune-token stops them (Scene 3) or turns them on Dorn (Scene 5).

stone-servant.name: Stone Servant
stone-servant.notes: Pulled out of the apron by Kolgrim’s note. Tries to shove PCs out of the ring and into the coal-cart fire. Crumbles to gravel the moment Kolgrim yields.

kolgrim.name: Kolgrim

reactions.name: Rock Catching
reactions.text: When a rock or similar object is hurled at Kolgrim, he makes a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw; on a success he catches it and takes no Bludgeoning damage from it.

kolgrim.notes: A ritual, not a murder. Yields at 100 HP and sits down hard; the servants collapse. A PC dropped to 0 is stable. Lost if the party yields or two of them are down. Opens with the boulder at whoever looks smallest; saves Vali-in-Large-Form for last.

thrunna.name: Thrunna Stonesinger
thrunna.notes: Never joins a fight. Speaks only Giant; the speaker who opens a conversation owns its end.

hushed.name: The Hushed

traits.name: Hush of the Deep
traits.text: The Hushed makes no sound and has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. A creature with Tremorsense (Boon, Orek with Stonecunning) still feels its steps on stone.

hushed.notes: Corvane’s agents. They want the Eye, not the party: round 1, one goes for Dorn. Grabbing the Eye burns them too (3d10 Psychic), so they try to drag Dorn to the slit. At the end of round 3 the stone takes Dorn; survivors fight one more round, then go out the slit on grapnels. A captured one talks (DC 15 Intimidation).

dorn.name: Dorn, Stone-Wed

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.text: If Dorn fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead. The Eye refuses to let him fail.

traits.name: Can’t Let Go
traits.text: Dorn never drops the Eye on his own. Disarming Attack, a grapple contest (his Athletics +2), dropping him to 0 HP or Boon’s talk-down are the ways to get it. Taking the Eye ends his fight.

traits.name: Stone to the Heart
traits.text: At 75 HP the floor raises Dorn on a 10-foot pillar: half cover from below, DC 14 Athletics to climb, he loses Stone Step, Dream-Shard becomes three bolts, and he gains a Reaction to bolt anyone who climbs on.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Dorn makes two Dream-Shard attacks (three while on the pillar).

actions.name: Dream-Shard
actions.text: Ranged Spell Attack Roll: +8, range 90 ft. Hit: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.

actions.name: The Mountain Shrugs (1/Day)
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, each creature in a 15-foot-radius Sphere Dorn can see. Failure: 10 (3d6) Bludgeoning damage and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.

bonus.name: Stone Step
bonus.text: Dorn sinks into the floor and rises from any stone within 30 feet.

reactions.name: Mountain’s Shield
reactions.text: Trigger: Dorn is hit by an attack roll. Response: +5 AC against that attack.

dorn.notes: Mage reskin (CR ~10). Doesn’t have to die: taking the Eye from him ends his fight. Kolgrim (if his test was won) gets one free Greatclub hit on him each round from round 3: 3d8 + 6.

groups.label: Round 3: the fourth, on the miners’ side
Kolgrim (ally, if his test was won)
